setupBody: Create an encrypted local binder on this device.
unlockBody: Your binder unlocks only in this browser session.
protectedBody: This protected workspace is available while the binder is unlocked.
passphraseRequirements: Use at least 12 characters. Your passphrase is not sent or stored.
noRecovery: There is no account recovery. If you lose this passphrase, the local binder cannot be recovered unless you have an exported backup.
passphraseAcknowledgment: I understand that Continuity Binder cannot recover this passphrase.
eraseConfirm: Erase the local binder and all encrypted records from this device? This cannot be undone.
invalidPassphrase: That passphrase could not unlock this binder.
autoLockHelp: Lock after this period of inactivity.
